title: Freeform — I'll describe my own system
promptText: Ask the candidate what system they would like to design, then interview them on it. Adapt to their chosen domain.

title: Design a URL Shortener
promptText: Design a URL shortening service like bit.ly. Consider hashing/encoding of short keys, read-heavy traffic, redirect latency, and analytics.

title: Design a Rate Limiter
promptText: Design a distributed rate limiter. Discuss algorithms (token bucket, sliding window), where it lives, and how state is shared across nodes.

title: Design a Chat Application (like WhatsApp)
promptText: Design a real-time chat system. Consider message delivery guarantees, presence, fan-out, persistence, and connection management at scale.

title: Design a News Feed (like Twitter/Instagram)
promptText: Design a social news feed. Discuss fan-out on write vs read, ranking, caching hot content, and handling celebrity users.

title: Design a Ride-Sharing Dispatch System
promptText: Design the dispatch system for a ride-sharing app. Consider geospatial indexing, matching drivers to riders, real-time location updates, and surge pricing.

title: Design a File Storage Service (like Dropbox)
promptText: Design a file storage & sync service. Consider chunking, deduplication, metadata, conflict resolution, and sync across devices.

title: Design a Notification System
promptText: Design a multi-channel notification system (push, email, SMS). Consider fan-out, delivery retries, rate limiting per user, and template management.
